caption: The drawing features an ornamental object resembling an intricate wooden carving set against a light beige background. The design is predominantly rendered in shades of brown, ochre, gold, and cream, with subtle highlights and shadows to create a three-dimensional effect. The carving forms a corner bracket shape, with a blue triangular section suggesting depth and separation from the background. The ornament incorporates stylized natural elements, such as curving leaves and scrolls, with layered, overlapping forms. At the end of the upward curve, there are two animal-like heads with distinct eyes and slightly open mouths. The object is positioned to the left and upper half of the composition, with ample blank space on the remaining background. The artist’s signature, “Ethel Dougan–1932,” is written in small text in the lower right area of the image.
title: Figurehead from Yacht
